BREAKING: US data center construction spending jumped +90% YoY in September, to a record annualized rate of $96.5 billion.

This also marks the largest YoY increase in 10 years.

This figure is now risen more than +60% YoY for 4 consecutive months.

Since the start of 2024, data center construction spending has nearly quadrupled.

Meanwhile, general office construction spending fell -8% YoY in September, to $46.0 billion, near its lowest level since January 2016.

This brought the gap between data center and general office construction spending to a record $50.5 billion.

Overall, US construction spending fell -1.9% MoM in September, its biggest monthly decline since April 2020.
